positive_snippets:
This hotel is situated just on walking distance from lajpat nagar market. I stayed with my wife and i really liked this property.
This hotel is couple friendly . Room is very neat and clean . Washroom is also very spacious and clean .
I highly recommend this hotel.
Have good parking space.
Staff is very polite.
Very good hotel. It was nice stay. Very well maintained. Service was good. Only drawback room has no window else everything was perfect.

Had a wonderful stay at Hotel Residency! The rooms were clean, spacious, and well-maintained, providing a comfortable and relaxing experience.

The staff was incredibly hospitable and always ready to assist with any requests.

The hotel’s location is convenient, making it easy to explore the city.

The food at the in-house restaurant was delicious, with a great variety of options.

Overall, a fantastic stay with excellent service—I would highly recommend Hotel Residency for both business and leisure.

Old world charm within this hotel tucked in Lajpat Nagar.
Amenities are basic and the staff is courteous. Ideal for a short stay during transit.
